confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kampot's riverside backpacker and expat market; no live listings or menus were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderate confidence. The 3-star hotel anchor is lower confidence because Kampot has few registered 3-star properties. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the local draft beer price because direct knowledge is weak. Kampot is small, so its prices may vary more than the anchors suggest.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is provincial Cambodian tourism towns such as Battambang, priced below the Siem Reap and Phnom Penh tourist cores, with a riverside leisure character similar to other small Southeast Asian backpacker towns.
